build_griffin_model: build a Griffin language model using Flax nn.Module with configurable layers and LRU-based temporal blocks
create_griffin_call: call the Griffin model with tokens and segment positions to compute logits and update inference cache
create_griffin_init_cache: create an empty inference cache for the Griffin model with a given batch size and dtype
test_griffin_forward: test the Griffin model forward pass with optional cache reuse and logits soft capping
review_griffin_setup: review the Griffin model setup method that initializes embedder, residual blocks, and final RMSNorm
